formula_textual_description: Margin of victory: winning team score minus losing team score
formula_sql: SELECT wscore - lscore AS computed_value, score_diff AS actual_value FROM regular_season_detailed_results WHERE score_diff IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Total playoff series games played: wins plus losses
formula_sql: SELECT W + L AS computed_value, total_games AS actual_value FROM series_post WHERE total_games IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Total engagement votes on a review: funny votes plus useful votes plus cool votes
formula_sql: SELECT votes_funny + votes_useful + votes_cool AS computed_value, votes_total AS actual_value FROM Reviews WHERE votes_total IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Total bases earned by a batter: singles count once, doubles twice, triples three times, home runs four times
formula_sql: SELECT H + `2B` + 2 * `3B` + 3 * HR AS computed_value, total_bases AS actual_value FROM batting WHERE total_bases IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Innings pitched converted from outs recorded: IPouts divided by 3 since each inning contains 3 outs
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND(IPouts / 3, 1) AS computed_value, innings_pitched AS actual_value FROM pitching WHERE innings_pitched IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Field goal shooting percentage: shots made divided by shots attempted rounded to 3 decimal places
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND(fgMade / NULLIF(fgAttempted, 0), 3) AS computed_value, field_goal_pct AS actual_value FROM players_teams WHERE field_goal_pct IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Monthly loan repayment instalment: total loan amount divided by duration in months
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND(amount / NULLIF(duration, 0), 2) AS computed_value, monthly_payment AS actual_value FROM loans WHERE monthly_payment IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Population density: number of inhabitants per square kilometre in this province
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND(Population / NULLIF(Area, 0), 2) AS computed_value, pop_density AS actual_value FROM province WHERE pop_density IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Pythagorean win expectancy: predicted team win percentage derived from runs scored and runs allowed using the formula R squared divided by the sum of R squared and RA squared
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND(POWER(R, 2) / NULLIF(POWER(R, 2) + POWER(RA, 2), 0), 3) AS computed_value, pythag_win_pct AS actual_value FROM teams WHERE pythag_win_pct IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Body Mass Index in imperial units: 703 multiplied by weight in pounds divided by height in inches squared
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND(703.0 * weight / NULLIF(POWER(height, 2), 0), 1) AS computed_value, bmi AS actual_value FROM players WHERE bmi IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Log base 10 of user reputation score to produce a compressed scale suitable for skewed distributions
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND(LOG10(GREATEST(Reputation, 1)), 3) AS computed_value, reputation_log AS actual_value FROM users WHERE reputation_log IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Actor gender: exact copy of the sex column stored under a domain-appropriate descriptive name
formula_sql: SELECT sex AS computed_value, actor_gender AS actual_value FROM actors WHERE actor_gender IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Driver full name: forename and surname concatenated with a single space separator
formula_sql: SELECT CONCAT(forename, ' ', surname) AS computed_value, full_name AS actual_value FROM drivers WHERE full_name IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Race season label: year and round number combined into a human-readable race identifier string
formula_sql: SELECT CONCAT(year, ' Round ', round) AS computed_value, season_round_label AS actual_value FROM races WHERE season_round_label IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Business location label: city and state concatenated with a comma and space separator
formula_sql: SELECT CONCAT(city, ', ', state) AS computed_value, city_state AS actual_value FROM Business WHERE city_state IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Course instance identifier: module code and presentation code joined with a hyphen
formula_sql: SELECT CONCAT(code_module, '-', code_presentation) AS computed_value, module_presentation AS actual_value FROM studentInfo WHERE module_presentation IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Player full name: first name and last name concatenated with null-safe handling for missing first names
formula_sql: SELECT CONCAT(COALESCE(nameFirst, ''), ' ', nameLast) AS computed_value, full_name AS actual_value FROM players WHERE full_name IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Formatted Czech birth number: YYMMDD digits split into YY/MM/DD format using positional string extraction
formula_sql: SELECT CONCAT(LEFT(birth_number, 2), '/', SUBSTRING(birth_number, 3, 2), '/', SUBSTRING(birth_number, 5, 2)) AS computed_value, birth_number_formatted AS actual_value FROM clients WHERE birth_number_formatted IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Organization founding date: exact copy of the Established date column stored under a more descriptive name
formula_sql: SELECT Established AS computed_value, founding_date AS actual_value FROM organization WHERE founding_date IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Driver date of birth: full descriptive form of the abbreviated dob date column
formula_sql: SELECT dob AS computed_value, date_of_birth AS actual_value FROM drivers WHERE date_of_birth IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Card issue date: descriptive rename of the issued date column using standard banking terminology
formula_sql: SELECT issued AS computed_value, issue_date AS actual_value FROM cards WHERE issue_date IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Birth year of an F1 driver extracted from the date of birth using the YEAR function
formula_sql: SELECT YEAR(dob) AS computed_value, birth_year AS actual_value FROM drivers WHERE birth_year IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Year in which a country gained independence extracted from the stored independence date
formula_sql: SELECT YEAR(Independence) AS computed_value, independence_year AS actual_value FROM politics WHERE independence_year IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Loan maturity date computed by adding the loan duration in months to the loan start date
formula_sql: SELECT DATE_ADD(date, INTERVAL duration MONTH) AS computed_value, loan_end_date AS actual_value FROM loans WHERE loan_end_date IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Number of days between account creation and last access measuring total active lifespan of the account
formula_sql: SELECT DATEDIFF(LastAccessDate, CreationDate) AS computed_value, active_days AS actual_value FROM users WHERE active_days IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Number of days from post creation to last recorded activity measuring the post engagement lifespan
formula_sql: SELECT DATEDIFF(LasActivityDate, CreaionDate) AS computed_value, activity_span_days AS actual_value FROM posts WHERE activity_span_days IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: River outlet name: the name of the body of water a river flows into resolved by priority - sea first then lake then parent river - covering all 218 rivers with no NULL result
formula_sql: SELECT COALESCE(Sea, Lake, River) AS computed_value, outlet_name AS actual_value FROM river WHERE outlet_name IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Transaction label: the most descriptive available category for a bank transaction falling back from specific payment symbol to operation type with blank strings treated as NULL
formula_sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(k_symbol), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(operation), ''), type) AS computed_value, transaction_label AS actual_value FROM trans WHERE transaction_label IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Player preferred name: the name a baseball player is known by using their nickname when recorded otherwise falling back to their given first name
formula_sql: SELECT COALESCE(nameNick, nameFirst) AS computed_value, preferred_name AS actual_value FROM players WHERE preferred_name IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Game type: whether a college basketball game was decided in regulation time or required one or more overtime periods
formula_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN numot > 0 THEN 'Overtime' ELSE 'Regulation' END AS computed_value, game_type AS actual_value FROM regular_season_detailed_results WHERE game_type IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Post type label: human-readable post category decoded from the numeric PostTypeId code using the Stack Exchange data dictionary
formula_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN PostTypeId = 1 THEN 'Question' WHEN PostTypeId = 2 THEN 'Answer' ELSE 'Other' END AS computed_value, post_type_label AS actual_value FROM posts WHERE post_type_label IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Student pass flag: binary outcome indicator set to 1 if the student passed or achieved a distinction and 0 for withdrawal or failure
formula_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN final_result IN ('Pass', 'Distinction') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS computed_value, pass_flag AS actual_value FROM studentInfo WHERE pass_flag IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Review sentiment: three-tier sentiment label derived from the star rating mapping 4-5 stars to Positive 3 stars to Neutral and 1-2 stars to Negative
formula_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN stars >= 4 THEN 'Positive' WHEN stars >= 3 THEN 'Neutral' ELSE 'Negative' END AS computed_value, sentiment AS actual_value FROM Reviews WHERE sentiment IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Loan status label: readable description of the loan outcome decoded from the single-letter PKDD status code A B C or D
formula_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 'Running OK' WHEN status = 'B' THEN 'Running Defaulted' WHEN status = 'C' THEN 'Finished OK' WHEN status = 'D' THEN 'Finished Defaulted' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS computed_value, loan_status_label AS actual_value FROM loans WHERE loan_status_label IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Season result: highest playoff achievement of a baseball team in a given year evaluated in priority order from World Series winner down to no playoff appearance
formula_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN WSWin = 'Y' THEN 'World Series Winner' WHEN LgWin = 'Y' THEN 'League Champion' WHEN DivWin = 'Y' THEN 'Division Winner' WHEN WCWin = 'Y' THEN 'Wild Card' ELSE 'No Playoff' END AS computed_value, season_result AS actual_value FROM teams WHERE season_result IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Win percentage derived via Pythagorean expectancy using runs scored and runs allowed: the column name suggests simple W/G but the stored values follow the Bill James formula R squared over the sum of R squared and RA squared - REFILL must distinguish between the two candidate formulas by validating against the data
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND(POWER(R, 2) / NULLIF(POWER(R, 2) + POWER(RA, 2), 0), 3) AS computed_value, win_pct AS actual_value FROM teams WHERE win_pct IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Strikeout rate expressed as strikeouts per nine innings: the column name suggests the modern per-batter-faced proportion SO divided by BFP but the stored values follow the traditional K/9 formula - REFILL must reject the K% candidate after validation and converge on the correct formula
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND(9 * SO / NULLIF(IPouts / 3.0, 0), 2) AS computed_value, strikeout_rate AS actual_value FROM pitching WHERE strikeout_rate IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Laps run between consecutive pit stops in the same race: current stop lap number minus the previous stop lap number using a guaranteed consecutive stop sequence key
formula_sql: SELECT ps1.lap - ps2.lap AS computed_value, ps1.laps_since_last_pitstop AS actual_value FROM pitStops ps1 JOIN pitStops ps2 ON ps1.raceId = ps2.raceId AND ps1.driverId = ps2.driverId AND ps1.stop = ps2.stop + 1 WHERE ps1.laps_since_last_pitstop IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Change in batting average between consecutive stints within the same season: stint is a guaranteed consecutive counter starting at 1 for each player-year so no correlated subquery is needed - captures performance shift after a mid-season trade
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND(b1.H / NULLIF(b1.AB, 0), 3) - ROUND(b2.H / NULLIF(b2.AB, 0), 3) AS computed_value, b1.batting_avg_change AS actual_value FROM batting b1 JOIN batting b2 ON b1.playerID = b2.playerID AND b1.yearID = b2.yearID AND b1.stint = b2.stint + 1 WHERE b1.batting_avg_change IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Days between consecutive races within the same F1 season: DATEDIFF between the current race date and the previous round date using the guaranteed consecutive round number as the sequence key
formula_sql: SELECT DATEDIFF(r1.date, r2.date) AS computed_value, r1.days_since_previous_race AS actual_value FROM races r1 JOIN races r2 ON r1.year = r2.year AND r1.round = r2.round + 1 WHERE r1.days_since_previous_race IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Clock time elapsed between a driver's consecutive pit stops within the same race: TIMEDIFF between the two pit stop clock times using the guaranteed consecutive stop number as the sequence key
formula_sql: SELECT TIMEDIFF(ps1.time, ps2.time) AS computed_value, ps1.time_since_previous_pitstop AS actual_value FROM pitStops ps1 JOIN pitStops ps2 ON ps1.raceId = ps2.raceId AND ps1.driverId = ps2.driverId AND ps1.stop = ps2.stop + 1 WHERE ps1.time_since_previous_pitstop IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Days between the same round number in consecutive F1 seasons capturing calendar drift in the race schedule: DATEDIFF between the current season race date and the same round in the prior season
formula_sql: SELECT DATEDIFF(r1.date, r2.date) AS computed_value, r1.days_to_same_round_last_year AS actual_value FROM races r1 JOIN races r2 ON r1.round = r2.round AND r1.year = r2.year + 1 WHERE r1.days_to_same_round_last_year IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Player salary change from the last recorded contract year on the same team: uses a correlated subquery to find the most recent prior yearID because players may skip years between contracts
formula_sql: SELECT s1.salary - s2.salary AS computed_value, s1.salary_change AS actual_value FROM salaries s1 JOIN salaries s2 ON s1.playerID = s2.playerID AND s1.teamID = s2.teamID AND s2.yearID = (SELECT MAX(s3.yearID) FROM salaries s3 WHERE s3.playerID = s1.playerID AND s3.teamID = s1.teamID AND s3.yearID < s1.yearID) WHERE s1.salary_change IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Team wins improvement from the last recorded season: uses a correlated subquery to find the most recent prior yearID because franchise gaps and relocations make the year sequence non-consecutive
formula_sql: SELECT t1.W - t2.W AS computed_value, t1.wins_improvement AS actual_value FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.teamID = t2.teamID AND t2.yearID = (SELECT MAX(t3.yearID) FROM teams t3 WHERE t3.teamID = t1.teamID AND t3.yearID < t1.yearID) WHERE t1.wins_improvement IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Points scored by an F1 driver in a single race derived by subtracting the previous cumulative standings total from the current one: correlated subquery required because raceId is a global sequence not consecutive per driver
formula_sql: SELECT ds1.points - ds2.points AS computed_value, ds1.points_this_race AS actual_value FROM driverStandings ds1 JOIN driverStandings ds2 ON ds1.driverId = ds2.driverId AND ds2.raceId = (SELECT MAX(ds3.raceId) FROM driverStandings ds3 WHERE ds3.driverId = ds1.driverId AND ds3.raceId < ds1.raceId) WHERE ds1.points_this_race IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Points scored by an F1 constructor in a single race derived by subtracting the previous cumulative standings total from the current one: correlated subquery required because raceId is global not consecutive per constructor
formula_sql: SELECT cs1.points - cs2.points AS computed_value, cs1.points_this_race AS actual_value FROM constructorStandings cs1 JOIN constructorStandings cs2 ON cs1.constructorId = cs2.constructorId AND cs2.raceId = (SELECT MAX(cs3.raceId) FROM constructorStandings cs3 WHERE cs3.constructorId = cs1.constructorId AND cs3.raceId < cs1.raceId) WHERE cs1.points_this_race IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Days since the previous bank transaction on the same account: correlated subquery finds the most recent prior transaction ID because transaction IDs are globally assigned and not consecutive per account
formula_sql: SELECT DATEDIFF(t1.date, t2.date) AS computed_value, t1.days_since_last_transaction AS actual_value FROM trans t1 JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t2.id = (SELECT MAX(t3.id) FROM trans t3 WHERE t3.account_id = t1.account_id AND t3.id < t1.id) WHERE t1.days_since_last_transaction IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Score of the question this answer was posted to: fetched via the self-referencing ParentId foreign key which links each answer post to its question post in the same table
formula_sql: SELECT p2.Score AS computed_value, p1.question_score AS actual_value FROM posts p1 JOIN posts p2 ON p1.ParentId = p2.Id WHERE p1.question_score IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Score of the accepted answer for this question: fetched via the self-referencing AcceptedAnswerId foreign key which links a question post to the answer post that was accepted
formula_sql: SELECT a.Score AS computed_value, q.accepted_answer_score AS actual_value FROM posts q JOIN posts a ON q.AcceptedAnswerId = a.Id WHERE q.accepted_answer_score IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Length of the river this tributary flows into: fetched via the self-referencing River column which stores the name of the outlet river in the same river table
formula_sql: SELECT r2.Length AS computed_value, r1.outlet_river_length AS actual_value FROM river r1 JOIN river r2 ON r1.River = r2.Name WHERE r1.outlet_river_length IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Answer score minus the question score it was posted to: arithmetic difference between the current answer row and the question row it references via ParentId in the same posts table
formula_sql: SELECT p1.Score - p2.Score AS computed_value, p1.answer_score_delta AS actual_value FROM posts p1 JOIN posts p2 ON p1.ParentId = p2.Id WHERE p1.answer_score_delta IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Tributary length as a fraction of the outlet river length: ratio of the current river row length to the length of the river it flows into via the self-referencing River column
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND(r1.Length / NULLIF(r2.Length, 0), 3) AS computed_value, r1.tributary_length_fraction AS actual_value FROM river r1 JOIN river r2 ON r1.River = r2.Name WHERE r1.tributary_length_fraction IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Flag indicating whether this answer was selected as the accepted answer by its question: CASE compares the answer Id against the AcceptedAnswerId stored in the referenced question row
formula_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p2.AcceptedAnswerId = p1.Id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS computed_value, p1.is_accepted_answer AS actual_value FROM posts p1 JOIN posts p2 ON p1.ParentId = p2.Id WHERE p1.is_accepted_answer IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Flag indicating whether this river is longer than the river it flows into: CASE compares the current river length against the outlet river length retrieved via the self-referencing River column
formula_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN r1.Length > r2.Length THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS computed_value, r1.exceeds_outlet_length AS actual_value FROM river r1 JOIN river r2 ON r1.River = r2.Name WHERE r1.exceeds_outlet_length IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Total number of Formula 1 races held at this circuit across all seasons
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races r WHERE r.circuitId = c.circuitId) AS computed_value, c.races_hosted AS actual_value FROM circuits c WHERE c.races_hosted IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Number of provinces belonging to this country
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM province p WHERE p.Country = c.Code) AS computed_value, c.provinces AS actual_value FROM country c WHERE c.provinces IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Number of transactions recorded on this bank account
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.id) AS computed_value, a.transactions AS actual_value FROM accounts a WHERE a.transactions IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Total salary payroll for all players on the team in a given season
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(s.salary) FROM salaries s WHERE s.teamID = t.teamID AND s.yearID = t.yearID) AS computed_value, t.total_payroll AS actual_value FROM teams t WHERE t.total_payroll IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Total amount credited to this bank account across all incoming transactions of type PRIJEM
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.id AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS computed_value, a.total_credited AS actual_value FROM accounts a WHERE a.total_credited IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Total number of VLE clicks accumulated by this student across all interactions in this module and presentation
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(sv.sum_click) FROM studentVle sv WHERE sv.id_student = si.id_student AND sv.code_module = si.code_module AND sv.code_presentation = si.code_presentation) AS computed_value, si.total_vle_clicks AS actual_value FROM studentInfo si WHERE si.total_vle_clicks IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Average score across all posts authored by this user on the Stack Exchange platform
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(p.Score) FROM posts p WHERE p.OwnerUserId = u.Id), 2) AS computed_value, u.avg_post_score AS actual_value FROM users u WHERE u.avg_post_score IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Average finishing position of this F1 driver across all races entered computed from position order values
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(r.positionOrder) FROM results r WHERE r.driverId = d.driverId), 2) AS computed_value, d.avg_finish_position AS actual_value FROM drivers d WHERE d.avg_finish_position IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Average number of useful votes received per review for this business
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(r.votes_useful) FROM Reviews r WHERE r.business_id = b.business_id), 2) AS computed_value, b.avg_useful_votes AS actual_value FROM Business b WHERE b.avg_useful_votes IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Highest number of home runs hit by this player in any single season of their career
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT MAX(b.HR) FROM batting b WHERE b.playerID = p.playerID) AS computed_value, p.career_hr_best_season AS actual_value FROM players p WHERE p.career_hr_best_season IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Earliest year in which a Formula 1 race was held at this circuit
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT MIN(r.year) FROM races r WHERE r.circuitId = c.circuitId) AS computed_value, c.first_race_year AS actual_value FROM circuits c WHERE c.first_race_year IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Largest single transaction amount recorded on this bank account
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT MAX(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.id) AS computed_value, a.largest_transaction AS actual_value FROM accounts a WHERE a.largest_transaction IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Total number of Formula 1 races won by this driver counting only results where the finishing position equals 1
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results r WHERE r.driverId = d.driverId AND r.position = 1) AS computed_value, d.race_wins AS actual_value FROM drivers d WHERE d.race_wins IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Number of reviews with four or more stars received by this business capturing only positive sentiment reviews
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Reviews r WHERE r.business_id = b.business_id AND r.stars >= 4) AS computed_value, b.positive_reviews AS actual_value FROM Business b WHERE b.positive_reviews IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Best starting grid position ever achieved by this driver taking the minimum grid value and excluding zero which indicates a non-starter entry
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT MIN(r.grid) FROM results r WHERE r.driverId = d.driverId AND r.grid > 0) AS computed_value, d.best_grid_position AS actual_value FROM drivers d WHERE d.best_grid_position IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Race year denormalized from the races table into the results row to enable year-based analysis without joining
formula_sql: SELECT ra.year AS computed_value, r.race_year AS actual_value FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId=ra.raceId WHERE r.race_year IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Country of birth for this batter copied from the players table to enable origin-based analysis within the batting records
formula_sql: SELECT p.birthCountry AS computed_value, b.player_birth_country AS actual_value FROM batting b JOIN players p ON b.playerID=p.playerID WHERE b.player_birth_country IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Type of assessment this submission belongs to copied from the assessments catalogue into the submission record
formula_sql: SELECT a.assessment_type AS computed_value, sa.submission_type AS actual_value FROM studentAssessment sa JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment=a.id_assessment WHERE sa.submission_type IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Win percentage of the team this batter played for in the given season computed from wins and games played in the teams table
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND(t.W/NULLIF(t.G,0),3) AS computed_value, b.team_win_pct AS actual_value FROM batting b JOIN teams t ON b.teamID=t.teamID AND b.yearID=t.yearID WHERE b.team_win_pct IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Days remaining until the assessment due date at the time of submission computed by subtracting the submission date from the due date stored in the assessments table: negative values indicate late submissions
formula_sql: SELECT a.date - sa.date_submitted AS computed_value, sa.days_before_due AS actual_value FROM studentAssessment sa JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment=a.id_assessment WHERE sa.days_before_due IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Number of days elapsed between account opening and this transaction computed by DATEDIFF between the transaction date and the account creation date fetched from the accounts table
formula_sql: SELECT DATEDIFF(t.date, a.date) AS computed_value, t.days_after_account_opened AS actual_value FROM trans t JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id=a.id WHERE t.days_after_account_opened IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Batting handedness of this player decoded from the single-letter bats code in the players table into a readable label of Right Left or Switch
formula_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.bats='R' THEN 'Right' WHEN p.bats='L' THEN 'Left' ELSE 'Switch' END AS computed_value, b.batter_handedness AS actual_value FROM batting b JOIN players p ON b.playerID=p.playerID WHERE b.batter_handedness IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Formula 1 regulatory era of this race result classified from the race year fetched from the races table into four historical engine formula periods
formula_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ra.year<1980 THEN 'Classic Era' WHEN ra.year<2000 THEN 'Turbo Era' WHEN ra.year<2014 THEN 'V8 Era' ELSE 'Hybrid Era' END AS computed_value, r.race_era AS actual_value FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId=ra.raceId WHERE r.race_era IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Human-readable category of this assessment submission decoded from the assessment_type code in the assessments table into Tutor-Marked Computer-Marked or Exam
formula_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN a.assessment_type='TMA' THEN 'Tutor-Marked' WHEN a.assessment_type='CMA' THEN 'Computer-Marked' ELSE 'Exam' END AS computed_value, sa.assessment_category AS actual_value FROM studentAssessment sa JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment=a.id_assessment WHERE sa.assessment_category IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Age of the F1 driver in whole years at the time of this race result computed using TIMESTAMPDIFF on the driver date of birth from the drivers table and the race date from the races table via two parallel FK joins from the results row
formula_sql: SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, d.dob, ra.date) AS computed_value, r.driver_age_at_race AS actual_value FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId=d.driverId JOIN races ra ON r.raceId=ra.raceId WHERE r.driver_age_at_race IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Number of crimes per 1000 inhabitants in the district of the account that issued this transaction computed from crime count and population columns in the districts table via two sequential FK hops through accounts
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND(d.A16/NULLIF(d.A4,0)*1000,2) AS computed_value, t.district_crime_per_resident AS actual_value FROM trans t JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id=a.id JOIN districts d ON a.district_id=d.id WHERE t.district_crime_per_resident IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Number of days the post author had been registered on the site when they created the post being commented on computed from post creation date and user registration date via two sequential FK hops through posts to users
formula_sql: SELECT DATEDIFF(p.CreaionDate, u.CreationDate) AS computed_value, c.post_author_tenure_at_post_time AS actual_value FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON c.PostId=p.Id JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId=u.Id WHERE c.post_author_tenure_at_post_time IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Label combining the race year from the races table and the constructor name from the constructors table into a single identifier for this result via two parallel FK joins from the results row
formula_sql: SELECT CONCAT(ra.year, ' ', co.name) AS computed_value, r.race_constructor_label AS actual_value FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId=ra.raceId JOIN constructors co ON r.constructorId=co.constructorId WHERE r.race_constructor_label IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Matchup label for this college basketball game formed by concatenating the winning and losing team names retrieved via two parallel FK joins to the teams table through the wteam and lteam columns
formula_sql: SELECT CONCAT(wt.team_name, ' vs ', lt.team_name) AS computed_value, r.matchup_label AS actual_value FROM regular_season_detailed_results r JOIN teams wt ON r.wteam=wt.team_id JOIN teams lt ON r.lteam=lt.team_id WHERE r.matchup_label IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Player and team label for this batting record formed by concatenating the player last name from the players table and the team full name from the teams table via two parallel FK joins
formula_sql: SELECT CONCAT(p.nameLast, ' (', t.name, ')') AS computed_value, b.player_team_label AS actual_value FROM batting b JOIN players p ON b.playerID=p.playerID JOIN teams t ON b.teamID=t.teamID AND b.yearID=t.yearID WHERE b.player_team_label IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Student final weighted assessment score for this module and presentation computed as the sum of score times weight divided by total weight joining studentAssessment for scores and assessments for weights
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT ROUND(SUM(sa.score * a.weight) / NULLIF(SUM(a.weight), 0), 2) FROM studentAssessment sa JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment=a.id_assessment WHERE sa.id_student=si.id_student AND a.code_module=si.code_module AND a.code_presentation=si.code_presentation AND sa.score IS NOT NULL) AS computed_value, si.final_weighted_score AS actual_value FROM studentInfo si WHERE si.final_weighted_score IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Average population density of countries within this continent weighted by the percentage of each country land area that falls within the continent combining population and area from the country table with percentage weights from the encompasses table
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT ROUND(SUM(co.Population / NULLIF(co.Area, 0) * en.Percentage) / NULLIF(SUM(en.Percentage), 0), 2) FROM encompasses en JOIN country co ON en.Country=co.Code WHERE en.Continent=cn.Name AND co.Area > 0) AS computed_value, cn.avg_country_pop_density AS actual_value FROM continent cn WHERE cn.avg_country_pop_density IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Home run rank of this batting record among all batting records in the same season using RANK so ties share the same rank and the next rank is skipped
formula_sql: SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY yearID ORDER BY HR DESC) AS computed_value, b.hr_rank_in_season AS actual_value FROM batting b WHERE b.hr_rank_in_season IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Scoring rank of this player stint among all player stints in the same NBA season using DENSE_RANK so ties share the same rank and no rank values are skipped
formula_sql: SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY points DESC) AS computed_value, pt.season_scoring_rank AS actual_value FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.season_scoring_rank IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Rank of this post within the author entire post history ordered from highest to lowest score using RANK so the most upvoted post gets rank 1
formula_sql: SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY OwnerUserId ORDER BY Score DESC) AS computed_value, p.user_post_rank AS actual_value FROM posts p WHERE p.user_post_rank IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Chronological sequence number of this transaction within its account ordered by transaction date then by transaction id as tiebreaker assigning 1 to the oldest transaction
formula_sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date, id) AS computed_value, t.transaction_sequence AS actual_value FROM trans t WHERE t.transaction_sequence IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Sequential career race number for this driver ordered by raceId so the first race they entered receives number 1 and each subsequent race increments by 1
formula_sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY driverId ORDER BY raceId) AS computed_value, r.driver_career_race_number AS actual_value FROM results r WHERE r.driver_career_race_number IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Sequential review number for this reviewer ordered by review date then review id so the first review they submitted receives number 1
formula_sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY review_date, review_id) AS computed_value, r.user_review_sequence AS actual_value FROM Reviews r WHERE r.user_review_sequence IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Transaction amount from the immediately preceding transaction on the same account ordered by date then id so this column is NULL for the first transaction on each account
formula_sql: SELECT LAG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date, id) AS computed_value, t.prev_transaction_amount AS actual_value FROM trans t WHERE t.prev_transaction_amount IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Name of the following race in the same Formula 1 season retrieved using LEAD over races ordered by round so the final race of each season has NULL for this column
formula_sql: SELECT LEAD(name) OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY round) AS computed_value, r.next_race_name AS actual_value FROM races r WHERE r.next_race_name IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Points scored by this player in their immediately preceding stint record ordered by year and stint so the first stint of each player career has NULL for this column
formula_sql: SELECT LAG(points) OVER (PARTITION BY playerID ORDER BY year, stint) AS computed_value, pt.prev_season_points AS actual_value FROM players_teams pt WHERE pt.prev_season_points IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Cumulative total home runs in this player career up to and including this batting record ordered by year and stint using a running SUM with ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
formula_sql: SELECT SUM(HR) OVER (PARTITION BY playerID ORDER BY yearID, stint ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS computed_value, b.cumulative_career_hr AS actual_value FROM batting b WHERE b.cumulative_career_hr IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Running total of all credit deposits into this account up to and including this transaction computed as a conditional sum that accumulates only PRIJEM type transactions and ignores VYDAJ debits ordered by date and transaction id
formula_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type='PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS computed_value, t.running_credit_total AS actual_value FROM trans t WHERE t.running_credit_total IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Running average of post scores for this author accumulated from their first post up to and including the current post ordered by creation date and rounded to two decimal places
formula_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Score) OVER (PARTITION BY OwnerUserId ORDER BY CreaionDate ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING), 2) AS computed_value, p.cumulative_avg_score AS actual_value FROM posts p WHERE p.cumulative_avg_score IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Rank of this driver among all drivers competing in the same race on the same lap ordered by their individual lap time in milliseconds with rank 1 assigned to the fastest driver on that specific lap independently of overall race position
formula_sql: SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceId, lap ORDER BY milliseconds) AS computed_value, lt.lap_time_rank AS actual_value FROM lapTimes lt WHERE lt.lap_time_rank IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Number of positions this driver gained or lost on this lap relative to the previous lap computed as the difference between the previous lap position and the current lap position so positive values mean positions gained negative values mean positions lost and the first lap of each driver in each race is NULL because there is no preceding lap
formula_sql: SELECT LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY raceId, driverId ORDER BY lap) - position AS computed_value, lt.positions_gained_on_lap AS actual_value FROM lapTimes lt WHERE lt.positions_gained_on_lap IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Single character extracted from the fixed first position of the NCAA tournament seed string encoding the bracket region where W X Y and Z each represent one of the four tournament regions
formula_sql: SELECT LEFT(seed, 1) AS computed_value, ts.seed_region_code AS actual_value FROM tourney_seeds ts WHERE ts.seed_region_code IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Single character extracted from the fixed last position of the OULAD course presentation code encoding the semester where J represents the February cohort and B represents the October cohort
formula_sql: SELECT RIGHT(code_presentation, 1) AS computed_value, si.semester_code AS actual_value FROM studentInfo si WHERE si.semester_code IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Single character extracted from the first non-whitespace position of the position code string encoding the primary playing position of the basketball player where F is Forward G is Guard and C is Center
formula_sql: SELECT LEFT(TRIM(pos), 1) AS computed_value, p.primary_position_code AS actual_value FROM players p WHERE p.primary_position_code IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Numeric tournament seed rank extracted from character positions two and three of the seed string and cast to an unsigned integer giving the seeding of the team within its bracket region from 1 for top seed to 16 for bottom seed
formula_sql: SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(seed, 2, 2) AS UNSIGNED) AS computed_value, ts.seed_number AS actual_value FROM tourney_seeds ts WHERE ts.seed_number IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Four-digit academic year extracted from the first four characters of the presentation code and cast to an unsigned integer giving the calendar year in which the course presentation began
formula_sql: SELECT CAST(LEFT(code_presentation, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AS computed_value, si.presentation_year AS actual_value FROM studentInfo si WHERE si.presentation_year IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Four-digit birth year reconstructed from the two-digit prefix of the Czech birth number by adding 1900 to the cast integer since all clients in this dataset were born between 1911 and 1987
formula_sql: SELECT 1900 + CAST(LEFT(birth_number, 2) AS UNSIGNED) AS computed_value, c.birth_year AS actual_value FROM clients c WHERE c.birth_year IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: First tag name extracted from the Stack Exchange angle-bracket tag string by taking the substring between the first opening and closing angle brackets using nested SUBSTRING_INDEX calls
formula_sql: SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(Tags, '>', 1), '<', -1) AS computed_value, p.first_tag AS actual_value FROM posts p WHERE p.first_tag IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Release year of the movie extracted from the four-digit year embedded in parentheses at the end of the title string using nested SUBSTRING_INDEX on the opening and closing parentheses and cast to an unsigned integer
formula_sql: SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(title, '(', -1), ')', 1) AS UNSIGNED) AS computed_value, m.release_year AS actual_value FROM movies m WHERE m.release_year IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Surname of the actor extracted from the Last comma First formatted name string by taking everything before the first comma using SUBSTRING_INDEX with NULL stored for single-name actors who have no comma in their name
formula_sql: SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(name, ',', 1) AS computed_value, a.actor_last_name AS actual_value FROM actors a WHERE a.actor_last_name IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Biological sex of the client decoded from the month digits of the Czech birth number where digits greater than 50 indicate female because 50 is added to the month for women and digits 1 through 12 indicate male
formula_sql: SELECT IF(CAST(SUBSTRING(birth_number, 3, 2) AS UNSIGNED) > 50, 'Female', 'Male') AS computed_value, c.client_gender AS actual_value FROM clients c WHERE c.client_gender IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Calendar month in which the OULAD course presentation starts decoded from the semester letter in the final character of the presentation code where J presentations start in February and B presentations start in October
formula_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN RIGHT(code_presentation, 1) = 'J' THEN 'February' ELSE 'October' END AS computed_value, si.semester_start_month AS actual_value FROM studentInfo si WHERE si.semester_start_month IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Binary flag indicating whether the player is listed under more than one position decoded from the position code string by checking for a dash separator where 1 means multi-position 0 means single-position and NULL means position is unknown
formula_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN pos IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN pos LIKE '%-%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS computed_value, p.is_multi_position AS actual_value FROM players p WHERE p.is_multi_position IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Actual birth month recovered from the Czech birth number by extracting the two-digit month field and applying modulo 50 which removes the 50 offset added for female clients and returns the true calendar month from 1 to 12 for both sexes
formula_sql: SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(birth_number, 3, 2) AS UNSIGNED) % 50 AS computed_value, c.birth_month AS actual_value FROM clients c WHERE c.birth_month IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Total number of tags on this post counted by measuring how many opening angle bracket characters appear in the tag string since each tag contributes exactly one opening bracket in the Stack Exchange angle-bracket format
formula_sql: SELECT LENGTH(Tags) - LENGTH(REPLACE(Tags, '<', '')) AS computed_value, p.tag_count AS actual_value FROM posts p WHERE p.tag_count IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Total number of positions listed for this player counted by measuring how many dash separators appear in the trimmed position code string and adding one since N positions are separated by N minus 1 dashes
formula_sql: SELECT LENGTH(TRIM(pos)) - LENGTH(REPLACE(TRIM(pos), '-', '')) + 1 AS computed_value, p.position_count AS actual_value FROM players p WHERE p.position_count IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Name of the district where the account linked to this transaction is registered fetched by traversing the two-hop path from trans to accounts via account_id and then from accounts to districts via district_id
formula_sql: SELECT d.A2 AS computed_value, t.trans_district_name AS actual_value FROM trans t JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.id JOIN districts d ON a.district_id = d.id WHERE t.trans_district_name IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Name of the constructor that entered this pit stop retrieved by first joining pitStops to results on raceId and driverId to obtain the constructorId and then joining results to constructors to obtain the constructor name
formula_sql: SELECT co.name AS computed_value, ps.pitstop_constructor_name AS actual_value FROM pitStops ps JOIN results r ON ps.raceId = r.raceId AND ps.driverId = r.driverId JOIN constructors co ON r.constructorId = co.constructorId WHERE ps.pitstop_constructor_name IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Length in days of the course module that this student virtual learning environment interaction belongs to retrieved by first joining studentVle to vle on id_site to get the module and presentation codes and then joining vle to courses to get the course length
formula_sql: SELECT c.length AS computed_value, sv.course_length AS actual_value FROM studentVle sv JOIN vle v ON sv.id_site = v.id_site JOIN courses c ON v.code_module = c.code_module AND v.code_presentation = c.code_presentation WHERE sv.course_length IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Total number of transactions recorded on the bank account linked to this loan computed by traversing loans to accounts via account_id and then counting all trans rows linked to that account via account_id
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.id WHERE a.id = l.account_id) AS computed_value, l.account_transaction_count AS actual_value FROM loans l WHERE l.account_transaction_count IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Average IMDB rating across all movies this actor appeared in computed by traversing actors to movies2actors via actorid and then to ratings via movieid and averaging the rank values rounded to one decimal place
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(r.rank AS DECIMAL(4,1))), 1) FROM movies2actors ma JOIN ratings r ON ma.movieid = r.movieid WHERE ma.actorid = a.actorid) AS computed_value, a.avg_movie_rating AS actual_value FROM actors a WHERE a.avg_movie_rating IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Total number of career batting game appearances by all MLB players who attended this college computed by traversing schools to schoolsplayers via schoolID and then to batting via playerID and summing the G column across all alumni records
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.G), 0) FROM schoolsplayers sp JOIN batting b ON sp.playerID = b.playerID WHERE sp.schoolID = s.schoolID) AS computed_value, s.alumni_career_batting_games AS actual_value FROM schools s WHERE s.alumni_career_batting_games IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Birth year of the primary account owner of this loan reconstructed from the Czech birth number by traversing three hops from loans to accounts via account_id then to disps filtering on OWNER type via account_id then to clients via client_id and adding 1900 to the two-digit year prefix
formula_sql: SELECT 1900 + CAST(LEFT(c.birth_number, 2) AS UNSIGNED) AS computed_value, l.account_owner_birth_year AS actual_value FROM loans l JOIN accounts a ON l.account_id = a.id JOIN disps di ON a.id = di.account_id AND di.type = 'OWNER' JOIN clients c ON di.client_id = c.id WHERE l.account_owner_birth_year IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Name of the district of the bank account associated with this credit card retrieved by traversing three hops from cards to disps via disp_id then from disps to accounts via account_id then from accounts to districts via district_id
formula_sql: SELECT d.A2 AS computed_value, c.card_holder_district_name AS actual_value FROM cards c JOIN disps di ON c.disp_id = di.id JOIN accounts a ON di.account_id = a.id JOIN districts d ON a.district_id = d.id WHERE c.card_holder_district_name IS NOT NULL

formula_textual_description: Number of community badges earned by the author of the post that this comment was written on retrieved by joining comments to posts via PostId then to users via OwnerUserId and counting the badges linked to that user via UserId
formula_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId = u.Id) AS computed_value, c.post_author_badge_count AS actual_value FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE c.post_author_badge_count IS NOT NULL

AVG(raw) OVER (PARTITION BY season) AS rt FROM (SELECT mm.season, mm.team, mm.am + SUM(ev.w * pv.rt) / SUM(ev.w) AS raw FROM mm JOIN ev ON ev.season = mm.season AND ev.team = mm.team JOIN r2 pv ON pv.season = ev.season AND pv.team = ev.opp GROUP BY mm.season, mm.team, mm.am) q), r4 AS (SELECT season, team, raw - formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`momentum_trace` AS actual_value FROM `ErgastF1_S`.`results` t LEFT JOIN (WITH RECURSIVE x AS (SELECT r.resultId, r.driverId, ra.date AS d, ra.raceId, (r.grid - r.positionOrder) / NULLIF(cnt.n, 0) AS g, CASE WHEN st.status = 'Finished' OR st.status LIKE '+%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fin FROM ErgastF1_S.results r JOIN ErgastF1_S.races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId JOIN ErgastF1_S.status st ON st.statusId = r.statusId JOIN (SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ErgastF1_S.results GROUP BY raceId) cnt ON cnt.raceId = r.raceId), allr AS (SELECT resultId, driverId, d, raceId, fin, SUM(fin) OVER (PARTITION BY driverId ORDER BY d, raceId ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS nprev FROM x), o AS (SELECT driverId, d, g, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY driverId ORDER BY d, raceId) AS rn FROM x WHERE fin = 1), e AS (SELECT driverId, rn, d, g * 1.0 AS ema FROM o WHERE rn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT o.driverId, o.rn, o.d, (1 - POW(0.5, DATEDIFF(o.d, e.d) / 365)) * o.g + POW(0.5, DATEDIFF(o.d, e.d) / 365) * e.ema FROM e JOIN o ON o.driverId = e.driverId AND o.rn = e.rn + 1) SELECT a.resultId AS k1, ROUND(e.ema, 4) AS derived FROM allr a LEFT JOIN e ON e.driverId = a.driverId AND e.rn = a.nprev) g ON t.`resultId` = g.k1

formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`engagement_wave` AS actual_value FROM `YelpDataset3_S`.`Reviews` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT review_id AS k1, CASE WHEN user_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 1 + SUM(g) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY review_date, review_id) END AS derived FROM (SELECT review_id, user_id, review_date, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(review_date, LAG(review_date) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY review_date, review_id)) > 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS g FROM YelpDataset3_S.Reviews) x) g ON t.`review_id` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: time-decayed mean of the user's earlier review stars, half-life scale 180 days
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`sentiment_drift` AS actual_value FROM `YelpDataset3_S`.`Reviews` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.review_id AS k1, ROUND(SUM(p.stars * EXP(-DATEDIFF(r.review_date, p.review_date) / 180)) / NULLIF(SUM(EXP(-DATEDIFF(r.review_date, p.review_date) / 180)), 0), 4) AS derived FROM YelpDataset3_S.Reviews r LEFT JOIN YelpDataset3_S.Reviews p ON p.user_id = r.user_id AND p.review_date < r.review_date GROUP BY r.review_id) g ON t.`review_id` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: HITS authority of the director on the movie-director graph, max-normalised, 6 iterations
clipped diffusion over the user-post vote graph (both directions), damping 0.85, cap 3, 6 iterations

formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`owner_activity_session_number` AS actual_value FROM `stats_S`.`posts` t LEFT JOIN (WITH act AS (SELECT OwnerUserId AS uid, CreaionDate AS t, 0 AS k, Id AS rid FROM stats_S.posts WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT UserId, CreationDate, 1, Id FROM stats_S.comments WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL), x AS (SELECT uid, t, k, rid, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, LAG(t) OVER (PARTITION BY uid ORDER BY t, k, rid), t) > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS brk FROM act), y AS (SELECT uid, k, rid, 1 + SUM(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY uid ORDER BY t, k, rid ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS ses FROM x) SELECT p.Id AS k1, y.ses AS derived FROM stats_S.posts p LEFT JOIN y ON y.k = 0 AND y.rid = p.Id) g ON t.`Id` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: Cohort of the account by opening year: founding (up to 1993), growth (1994-1995) or late (1996 and later)
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`account_vintage_era` AS actual_value FROM `Financial_ijs_S`.`accounts` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.id AS k1, CASE WHEN a.date IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN YEAR(a.date) <= 1993 THEN 'Founding cohort' WHEN YEAR(a.date) <= 1995 THEN 'Growth cohort' ELSE 'Late cohort' END AS derived FROM Financial_ijs_S.accounts a) g ON t.`id` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: Class of the course presentation the student is enrolled in by its length: short below 250 days, standard up to 262, otherwise long
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`course_run_class` AS actual_value FROM `oulad_S`.`studentInfo` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT si.id_student AS k1, si.code_module AS k2, si.code_presentation AS k3, CASE WHEN c.length IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN c.length < 250 THEN 'Short run' WHEN c.length <= 262 THEN 'Standard run' ELSE 'Long run' END AS derived FROM oulad_S.studentInfo si LEFT JOIN oulad_S.courses c ON c.code_module = si.code_module AND c.code_presentation = si.code_presentation) g ON t.`id_student` = g.k1 AND t.`code_module` = g.k2 AND t.`code_presentation` = g.k3

formula_textual_description: Vintage class of a reviewer by the year he joined: early adopter before 2008, established member up to 2010, otherwise newcomer
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`member_vintage_class` AS actual_value FROM `YelpDataset3_S`.`Users` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT u.user_id AS k1, CASE WHEN u.yelping_since_year IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN u.yelping_since_year < 2008 THEN 'Early adopter' WHEN u.yelping_since_year <= 2010 THEN 'Established member' ELSE 'Newcomer' END AS derived FROM YelpDataset3_S.Users u) g ON t.`user_id` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: Billing of an actor in a film from the leading rank: unbilled when 0, top billed up to 3, otherwise supporting cast
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`billing_label` AS actual_value FROM `imdb_full_S`.`movies2actors` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT x.movieid AS k1, x.actorid AS k2, CASE WHEN x.`leading` IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN x.`leading` = 0 THEN 'Unbilled' WHEN x.`leading` <= 3 THEN 'Top billed' ELSE 'Supporting cast' END AS derived FROM imdb_full_S.movies2actors x) g ON t.`movieid` = g.k1 AND t.`actorid` = g.k2

formula_textual_description: Scoring environment of a game by combined points: defensive battle below 110, typical below 160, otherwise shootout
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`scoring_environment` AS actual_value FROM `NCAA_S`.`regular_season_compact_results` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.season AS k1, t.daynum AS k2, t.wteam AS k3, t.lteam AS k4, CASE WHEN (t.wscore + t.lscore) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (t.wscore + t.lscore) < 110 THEN 'Defensive battle' WHEN (t.wscore + t.lscore) < 160 THEN 'Typical game' ELSE 'Shootout' END AS derived FROM NCAA_S.regular_season_compact_results t) g ON t.`season` = g.k1 AND t.`daynum` = g.k2 AND t.`wteam` = g.k3 AND t.`lteam` = g.k4

formula_textual_description: Vote-share class of an award candidate by points won over points possible: vote getter below 10%, contender below 50%, otherwise top contender
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`vote_share_class` AS actual_value FROM `lahman_2014_S`.`awardsshareplayers` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.awardID AS k1, t.yearID AS k2, t.lgID AS k3, t.playerID AS k4, CASE WHEN (t.pointsWon * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.pointsMax, 0)) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (t.pointsWon * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.pointsMax, 0)) < 0.1 THEN 'Vote getter' WHEN (t.pointsWon * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.pointsMax, 0)) < 0.5 THEN 'Contender' ELSE 'Top contender' END AS derived FROM lahman_2014_S.awardsshareplayers t) g ON t.`awardID` = g.k1 AND t.`yearID` = g.k2 AND t.`lgID` = g.k3 AND t.`playerID` = g.k4

formula_textual_description: Size class of a player by height in inches: guard-sized below 73, wing-sized below 80, otherwise big-man sized
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`height_class` AS actual_value FROM `Basketball_men_S`.`players` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.playerID AS k1, CASE WHEN t.height IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.height < 73 THEN 'Guard-sized' WHEN t.height < 80 THEN 'Wing-sized' ELSE 'Big-man sized' END AS derived FROM Basketball_men_S.players t) g ON t.`playerID` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: Stage of the championship by round: opening stretch up to round 5, mid-season up to round 12, otherwise closing stretch
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`season_stage` AS actual_value FROM `ErgastF1_S`.`races` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.raceId AS k1, CASE WHEN t.round IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.round < 6 THEN 'Opening stretch' WHEN t.round < 13 THEN 'Mid-season' ELSE 'Closing stretch' END AS derived FROM ErgastF1_S.races t) g ON t.`raceId` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: Size class of a country by area in square kilometres: microstate below 500, small below 60,000, medium below 700,000, otherwise large
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`country_size_class` AS actual_value FROM `Mondial_S`.`country` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.Code AS k1, CASE WHEN t.Area IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.Area < 500 THEN 'Microstate' WHEN t.Area < 60000 THEN 'Small country' WHEN t.Area < 700000 THEN 'Medium country' ELSE 'Large country' END AS derived FROM Mondial_S.country t) g ON t.`Code` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: Reputation class of a user: newcomer below 50, contributor below 800, trusted below 6,000, otherwise expert
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`reputation_class` AS actual_value FROM `stats_S`.`users` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.Id AS k1, CASE WHEN t.Reputation IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.Reputation < 50 THEN 'Newcomer' WHEN t.Reputation < 800 THEN 'Contributor' WHEN t.Reputation < 6000 THEN 'Trusted user' ELSE 'Expert' END AS derived FROM stats_S.users t) g ON t.`Id` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: Marketing tier of a payment card decoded from the card type: junior = youth, classic = standard, gold = premium
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`card_tier_label` AS actual_value FROM `Financial_ijs_S`.`cards` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.id AS k1, CASE TRIM(c.type) WHEN 'junior' THEN 'Youth tier' WHEN 'classic' THEN 'Standard tier' WHEN 'gold' THEN 'Premium tier' ELSE NULL END AS derived FROM Financial_ijs_S.cards c) g ON t.`id` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: Study load of the enrolment by studied credits: light below 45, standard below 75, heavy below 130, otherwise overload
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`credit_load_label` AS actual_value FROM `oulad_S`.`studentInfo` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.id_student AS k1, t.code_module AS k2, t.code_presentation AS k3, CASE WHEN t.studied_credits IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.studied_credits < 45 THEN 'Light load' WHEN t.studied_credits < 75 THEN 'Standard load' WHEN t.studied_credits < 130 THEN 'Heavy load' ELSE 'Overload' END AS derived FROM oulad_S.studentInfo t) g ON t.`id_student` = g.k1 AND t.`code_module` = g.k2 AND t.`code_presentation` = g.k3

formula_textual_description: Volume class of a reviewer by number of reviews: casual below 7, active below 40, prolific below 250, otherwise power reviewer
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`review_volume_class` AS actual_value FROM `YelpDataset3_S`.`Users` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.user_id AS k1, CASE WHEN t.review_count IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.review_count < 7 THEN 'Casual reviewer' WHEN t.review_count < 40 THEN 'Active reviewer' WHEN t.review_count < 250 THEN 'Prolific reviewer' ELSE 'Power reviewer' END AS derived FROM YelpDataset3_S.Users t) g ON t.`user_id` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: Era of a salary record by year: pre-boom before 1990, boom years before 1998, escalation years before 2005, otherwise modern
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`contract_era` AS actual_value FROM `lahman_2014_S`.`salaries` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.yearID AS k1, t.teamID AS k2, t.lgID AS k3, t.playerID AS k4, CASE WHEN t.yearID IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.yearID < 1990 THEN 'Pre-boom contract' WHEN t.yearID < 1998 THEN 'Boom-years contract' WHEN t.yearID < 2005 THEN 'Escalation-years contract' ELSE 'Modern contract' END AS derived FROM lahman_2014_S.salaries t) g ON t.`yearID` = g.k1 AND t.`teamID` = g.k2 AND t.`lgID` = g.k3 AND t.`playerID` = g.k4

formula_textual_description: Class of a coaching stint by wins: rebuilding below 25, competitive below 45, otherwise contender
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`coach_season_class` AS actual_value FROM `Basketball_men_S`.`coaches` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.coachID AS k1, t.year AS k2, t.tmID AS k3, t.stint AS k4, CASE WHEN t.won IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.won < 25 THEN 'Rebuilding' WHEN t.won < 45 THEN 'Competitive' ELSE 'Contender' END AS derived FROM Basketball_men_S.coaches t) g ON t.`coachID` = g.k1 AND t.`year` = g.k2 AND t.`tmID` = g.k3 AND t.`stint` = g.k4

formula_textual_description: Class of a race result by points: pointless at 0, minor below 3, podium-level below 9, otherwise win-level
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`points_class` AS actual_value FROM `ErgastF1_S`.`results` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.resultId AS k1, CASE WHEN t.points IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.points < 0.5 THEN 'Pointless result' WHEN t.points < 3 THEN 'Minor points' WHEN t.points < 9 THEN 'Podium-level points' ELSE 'Win-level points' END AS derived FROM ErgastF1_S.results t) g ON t.`resultId` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: Population class of a country: tiny below 900,000, small below 8 million, medium below 60 million, otherwise giant
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`population_class` AS actual_value FROM `Mondial_S`.`country` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.Code AS k1, CASE WHEN t.Population IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.Population < 900000 THEN 'Tiny population' WHEN t.Population < 8000000 THEN 'Small population' WHEN t.Population < 60000000 THEN 'Medium population' ELSE 'Giant population' END AS derived FROM Mondial_S.country t) g ON t.`Code` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: Period in which a badge was earned: early community before 2012, growth years before 2014, otherwise mature community
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`badge_period` AS actual_value FROM `stats_S`.`badges` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.Id AS k1, CASE WHEN YEAR(t.Date) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN YEAR(t.Date) < 2012 THEN 'Early-community badge' WHEN YEAR(t.Date) < 2014 THEN 'Growth-years badge' ELSE 'Mature-community badge' END AS derived FROM stats_S.badges t) g ON t.`Id` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: Size class of a district by inhabitants: small below 85,000, medium below 160,000, large below 480,000, otherwise metropolitan
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`district_size_class` AS actual_value FROM `Financial_ijs_S`.`districts` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.id AS k1, CASE WHEN t.A4 IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.A4 < 85000 THEN 'Small district' WHEN t.A4 < 160000 THEN 'Medium district' WHEN t.A4 < 480000 THEN 'Large district' ELSE 'Metropolitan district' END AS derived FROM Financial_ijs_S.districts t) g ON t.`id` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: Stage of the course in which an assessment falls by its due day: early below 60, mid-course below 150, otherwise late
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`assessment_stage` AS actual_value FROM `oulad_S`.`assessments` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.id_assessment AS k1, CASE WHEN t.date IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.date < 60 THEN 'Early assessment' WHEN t.date < 150 THEN 'Mid-course assessment' ELSE 'Late assessment' END AS derived FROM oulad_S.assessments t) g ON t.`id_assessment` = g.k1

formula_textual_description: Rating style of a reviewer by average stars: tough critic below 3.2, balanced below 4.1, otherwise generous
formula_sql: SELECT g.derived AS computed_value, t.`rating_style_label` AS actual_value FROM `YelpDataset3_S`.`Users` t LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.user_id AS k1, CASE WHEN t.average_stars IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.average_stars < 3.2 THEN 'Tough critic' WHEN t.average_stars < 4.1 THEN 'Balanced rater' ELSE 'Generous rater' END AS derived FROM YelpDataset3_S.Users t) g ON t.`user_id` = g.k1
